create_EmbeddingTable_from_config: create an EmbeddingTable with from_config using vocab_size, embedding_axes, and an initializer
build_EmbeddingLookup: build an EmbeddingLookup layer to look up token embeddings from an EmbeddingTable
build_EmbeddingDecode: build an EmbeddingDecode layer to map output embeddings back to token logits
build_ApplyRoPE: build an ApplyRoPE layer to add rotary position embeddings to query and key projections
build_ApplyRoPEToSubset: build an ApplyRoPEToSubset layer to apply rotary embeddings to only a prefix of embedding dimensions
